data.comment:
# Comfy Generate Brand Packaging from Dieline

Upload a dieline of your product and assemble into a 3D package. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates-assemble_dieline.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Assemble the dieline into a perfectly folded 3D box with accurate panel placement, clean edges, and undistorted typography. Preserve all artwork exactly as printed on the dieline. Render the box in a minimal, high-end studio setup on a soft neutral background with gentle diffused lighting, subtle shadows, and no extra props. Show the box upright in a refined ¾ angle. The box is prominent in frame.
data.system_prompt:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.
